# rustinion_log_archive_destination (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion long-term S3 log/metric archival destination: archives aging device_logs/device_metrics_samples/custom_metric_samples rows to a customer-owned S3 bucket before retention deletes them. One destination per tenant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key_id` (String) The AWS IAM access key id for a customer-owned bucket the customer has already created and granted access to. Not updatable -- rotating credentials means destroying and recreating this resource.
- `bucket` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The AWS IAM secret access key, paired with access_key_id. Write-only: the API never returns this value at any point, not even once, so it is not updatable via Update either (a real, stated v1 scope cut) -- rotate it by destroying and recreating this resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to true on create.
- `prefix` (String) An optional key prefix under the bucket. Empty string (the default) archives directly at the bucket root.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
